actions.name: Attack
actions.description: Make one melee or ranged attack

actions.name: Cast a Spell
actions.description: Cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action

actions.name: Dash
actions.description: Gain extra movement equal to your speed for the current turn

actions.name: Disengage
actions.description: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn

actions.name: Dodge
actions.description: Focus on avoiding attacks: attacks against you have disadvantage, Dex saves have advantage

actions.name: Help
actions.description: Lend aid to an ally's ability check or attack roll (granting advantage)

actions.name: Hide
actions.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to become unseen

actions.name: Ready
actions.description: Prepare a reaction to act upon a specified trigger

actions.name: Search
actions.description: Devote attention to finding something (Perception or Investigation check)

actions.name: Use an Object
actions.description: Interact with an object requiring your full action
